title: collapse_by_thread: unnecessary .clone() on owned values from into_iter()
description: email.rs:774-777: 'emails.into_iter().map(|e| (e.id.clone(), e.thread_id.clone())).collect()' — into_iter() produces owned Email values. Calling .clone() on fields of an owned value is gratuitous; the fields can be moved directly: '|e| (e.id, e.thread_id)'. clippy::clippy::redundant_clone would catch this.
